_comment: Drives the link-in-bio page at /links (served as https://shauna.dev/).
Adding a link = adding one entry. Nothing else needs to change.
bars[].variant  plain | dark | teal | tint | quiet   (see links.astro rest-state block)
bars[].span     grid columns out of 6. Everything is 6 today; 3 gives a half-width bar.
bars[].href     omit or null + "placeholder": true to render a non-linking TBD bar.
The Writing section points at shauna.digital's blog and is HARDCODED below.
It used to be derived from the blog content collection, which meant this repo
had to carry all 13 posts just to count them. Publishing a post on
shauna.digital no longer updates this page: bump latestPostSlug, latestTitle
and latestReadTime by hand. Verified correct 2026-08-14 against the live blog.
Nothing validates these — a wrong slug is a 404 nobody notices.
postCount was removed 2026-08-14. These are two links, one to an article and
one to the archive; a total added nothing and was the field most certain to
go stale, since any new post makes a count wrong immediately.

socials._note: WhatsApp INVITE link (wa.me/qr/...), deliberately not wa.me/<number>. A number-form link would publish Shauna's personal mobile in the page source for scrapers; this opaque code does not. Tradeoff: it carries no prefilled message, and it BREAKS SILENTLY if the QR is ever reset in WhatsApp. If that happens, re-copy the link from the app. Verified resolving 2026-08-12.

_comment: Projects in build. Rendered as NON-LINKING bars. Countdown Project and
Thread Hawaiʻi both went live and MOVED UP to "bars" on 2026-08-13.
Island Bound is the only one left: no domain is registered for it yet and
the repo is still pre-implementation (Phase 0 research complete), so there
is nothing to link.
TO TAKE IT LIVE: move the entry into "bars" with an href and a variant.
Do NOT just add an href here — index.astro renders every item in this list
as a <span>, unconditionally. It never reads the "building" flag, so an
href on this side is silently ignored. (The old comment claimed otherwise.)
Verify the URL actually serves before linking it: the standing trap on
these domains is a Namecheap URL Redirect Record answering with
'X-Served-By: Namecheap URL Forward', which looks alive but is a parking
page. Delete that record FIRST, then point DNS at the host.
